teaser.en: Cut any part of this tree and it bleeds blood-red sap, and the Digo of Diani boil its bark against malaria.
teaser.sw: Kata sehemu yoyote ya mti huu nao utatoa utomvu mwekundu kama damu, na Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome lake kutibu malaria.
teaser.dg: Uchikata seemu yoyosi ya muhi hinyu, unalavya maziya ga kundu dza mlatso, na Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gophare kuhenda dawa ya homa.

summary.en: *Mkonotsaka*, the orange-milk tree, is a fast-growing pioneer of forest edges and clearings that bleeds orange to blood-red sap. Its root and stem bark are among the Digo's best-known malaria remedies, and its sap gives a dye.
summary.sw: *Mkonotsaka*, au mbura, ni mti waanzilishi unaokua haraka wa pembezoni mwa misitu na sehemu zilizofyekwa, unaotoa utomvu wa rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu kama damu. Gome la mizizi na la shina lake ni miongoni mwa dawa za malaria zinazojulikana zaidi kwa Wadigo, na utomvu wake hutoa rangi.
summary.dg: *Mkonotsaka* (kpwa Chingereza *orange-milk tree*) ni muhi unaokula upesi, mwenga wa mihi ya kpwandza kumera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na phatu phariphokatwa mihi, unaolavya maziya ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ga kundu dza mlatso. Gopha ra mizi na ra kolo ni kahi ya madawa ga homa ganagomanyikana sana ni Adigo, na maziyage ganalavya rangi.

about.en:
*Mkonotsaka* is a pioneer, one of the first trees to move into a clearing. Its young shoots are covered in orange-brown hairs, and the leaves grow in opposite pairs. The surest sign is the sap: any cut, on twig, leaf or bark, oozes blood-red or orange latex.

The small fruits come in large clusters at the branch ends.
about.sw:
*Mkonotsaka* ni mti waanzilishi, mmojawapo wa miti ya kwanza kuota katika sehemu iliyofyekwa. Machipukizi yake machanga yamefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya chungwa-kahawia, na majani hukua kwa jozi zinazoelekeana. Dalili ya uhakika zaidi ni utomvu: kidonda chochote, kwenye kitawi, jani au gome, hutiririsha utomvu mwekundu kama damu au wa rangi ya chungwa.

Matunda yake madogo huja kwa vishada vikubwa kwenye ncha za matawi.
about.dg:
*Mkonotsaka* ni mwenga wa mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi. Mapanda madide matsanga gana nyere za rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, na makodza ganamera jozi-jozi, mwenga kpwa chila uphande. Alama ya kpweli zaidi ni maziya: phatu phophosi uchikataho, ichikala ni liphungo, kodza au gopha, ganatuluka maziya ga kundu dza mlatso au ga rangi ya chungbwa.

Matunda madide ganamera kpwa mabunda makulu kpwenye ntsa za panda.

where.en: Look for it at forest edges, in clearings and in moist secondary bush, places where forest is growing back.
where.sw: Utafute pembezoni mwa misitu, katika sehemu zilizofyekwa na katika vichaka vya pili vyenye unyevu, mahali ambapo msitu unaota upya.
where.dg: Hendza kanda-kanda ya matsaka, phatu phariphokatwa mihi, na kpwenye vitsaka vya phatu pha jeke-jeke, ambapho tsaka rinamera tsona.

uses.en:
Among the Digo of Diani, the root and stem bark are boiled as a treatment for malaria. In a study of Digo malaria remedies (Nguta and colleagues, 2011) healers agreed strongly on this use.

The sap is used as a dye, and the wood is used for poles and mortars.
uses.sw:
Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani, gome la mizizi na la shina huchemshwa kama tiba ya malaria. Katika utafiti wa dawa za malaria za Wadigo (Nguta na wenzake, 2011) waganga walikubaliana kwa kiasi kikubwa juu ya matumizi haya.

Utomvu hutumika kama rangi, na mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo na vinu.
uses.dg:
Kpwa Adigo a Diani, gopha ra mizi na ra kolo nkuchemushwa kuhenda dawa ya homa. Kpwenye utafiti wa madawa ga homa ga Adigo (Nguta na anjina, 2011), aganga akakubaliana sana kuhusu kazi hino.

Maziya nkuhumirwa kuhenda rangi, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na vinu.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives two Digo names, *mkonotsaka* and *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* is also recorded for *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), another pioneer of clearings. In Swahili it is *mbura*, and in English the orange-milk tree.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkonotsaka* na *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* pia limerekodiwa kwa *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), mti mwingine waanzilishi wa sehemu zilizofyekwa. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mbura*, na kwa Kiingereza *orange-milk tree*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mkonotsaka* na *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* piya rinahumirwa kpwa *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), muhi wanjina wa kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mbura*, na kpwa Chingereza *orange-milk tree*.

reason.dg: Naye ni wa kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi, na piya unaihwa mbonobono

reason.sw: Dawa nyingine ya malaria ya Wadigo
reason.dg: Dawa yanjina ya homa ya Adigo

reason.en: Baobab leaves are also boiled for malaria in Diani
reason.sw: Majani ya mbuyu pia huchemshwa kwa malaria huko Diani
reason.dg: Makodza ga muuyu piya nkuchemushwa kuhenda dawa ya homa Diani
